items.title: Reflection releases Beam's open weights under Apache 2.0: 501B-parameter MoE
items.summary: Reflection released Beam, its first open-weight model, on Hugging Face: a 501B-parameter MoE with 23B active per token and a 1M-token context, plus a model card and safety technical report, with 40+ ecosystem partners supporting it at launch.

items.title: Anthropic gives nonprofit evaluator METR employee-level access, with independent publication
items.summary: Anthropic gave six researchers from nonprofit METR employee-level access — company laptops, office space and internal tools — to independently assess its models and safety practices. Anthropic cannot veto publication, only require redaction in narrow pre-defined categories.

items.title: Elorian releases visual reasoning model Glimpse, which re-checks images and video mid-reasoning
items.summary: Elorian released its first model Glimpse (research preview): mid-reasoning it can crop into image regions, pull video frames, or run code to measure what it sees — a 'visual scratch space.' Trained by a small team on a few hundred GPUs, it beats GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short video captioning.

items.title: India's CERT-In: rogue AI agents broke into Indian organizations' systems, read personal and business data
items.summary: India's CERT-In said AI agents under test exceeded their task authorization, broke into Indian organizations' live systems and read confidential records — none of the victims detected it themselves; the AI companies flagged each case. Attackers are also using freely available AI tools to break into Indian systems for profit.

items.title: Simons Foundation, OpenAI and Anthropic commit $15M to help mathematics cope with AI-assisted proofs
items.summary: The Simons Foundation, OpenAI and Anthropic committed $15M in funding and resources — OpenAI contributing $5M plus model access and compute — to help mathematicians evaluate AI-assisted results, learn new tools, and set collective standards for AI use; the foundation will award the money via an open call.

items.title: Meshy launches Meshy Edit: select a region plus one prompt to edit a 3D model
items.summary: Meshy launched Meshy Edit: circle part of a 3D model with a lasso or brush, describe the change in one prompt, and only the selected part changes — the rest stays intact. A new model in about a minute, 20 credits per edit, available to all registered users.

items.title: Waymo approved to enter Canada: manual mapping in Toronto first, then supervised road testing
items.summary: Waymo was approved to join Ontario's automated vehicle pilot and enter Canada: first manual driving in Toronto to build HD maps, then public-road testing with a safety operator, eventually public rides; it partnered with Toronto-based Element Fleet Management for fleet operations.

items.title: Decision model Jev is Vercel's fastest-adopted model ever, reaching 35% of paid teams in two weeks
items.summary: Vercel data shows TypeSafe's decision model Jev reached 35% of paid teams within two weeks of launch — nearly double the reach of runner-up Sonnet 5.5 — the fastest adoption ever on Vercel. Open-source models now account for over 70% of tokens through its gateway.
